messages:
people-ops-bot: Heads-up! Diego's birthday is coming up on Thu Apr 2. Options for celebrating — react with :one:, :two:, or :three: or reply with your preference. 1) In-office breakfast 10:30am (croissants + fruit) 2) Ship snack boxes to remote folks 3) E-gift card to a cafe. RSVP by EOD Wed.
harriet (People Ops): Quick note — we can do both in-office + boxes if ppl want, but need a headcount for GF/vegan. also can volunteer signups.
diego: ahh thanks!! honestly whatever's easiest for the team. i'm ok with boxes so remote teammates don't miss out 🙂
sana: :two: please. also gluten-free option for me if possible.
leo: :two: + :tada: send snack boxes.
mira: i'd love to bring coffee if we do breakfast. what time would that be?
harriet (People Ops): plan is 10:30am in the office. @mira that would be amazing — small urn and disposable cups ok? i'll order boxes from FlourishCo (they do GF and nut-free).
diego: no candles pls (allergic to smoke detectors 😅). coffee and croissants sounds perfect tho.
sana: adding a quick note — allergic to tree nuts, please mark boxes nut-free for me.
harriet (People Ops): noted. signup form: https://forms.gle/diego-bday-signup — pick option 1/2/3 and indicate dietary needs. i'll close responses Wed 5pm and place order.
leo: :thumbsup: I'll pick up pastries if needed.
people-ops-bot: Event created: "Diego — Birthday Treat" • 2026-04-02 10:30 — Calendar invite sent to team. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abc123
diego: thanks everyone, you guys are the best <3
harriet (People Ops): final reminder — please fill the form if you haven't. planning to include a little handwritten card from the team. :heart:
